description: Lists Relay models by tag and/or text. Common tags: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, text-to-text, text-to-embedding. image-to-image also lists every image model that takes an input image. Returns name, tag, route and accepts (input media the model takes, e.g. ["image"]; [] for none) per model (at most 50). With a credential the list is your account's view (what its tier and grants can run), public otherwise. Then call get_model with a name for its input schema.

query.description: Words to match, case-insensitive; every word must appear in the name, display name or tag (e.g. 'kling v3').

tag.description: Model type tag, e.g. text-to-image or image-to-video. Omit for every tag.
